optimize_pytorch_model: optimize a PyTorch model by reordering its computation graph nodes using an ILP solver
optimize_model_with_loss: optimize a training model by passing the model, inputs, loss function, and optimizer to optimize()
optimize_model_no_reordering: optimize a PyTorch model with node reordering disabled by setting node_reordering to False
run_optimized_model_forward: run the forward pass of an OptimizedModel returned by optimize() with input tensor x
review_optimize_function: review the optimize function that imports a PyTorch model into a data flow graph and runs an ILP solver
